description.text: One of the second pair of Scarlet & Violet expansions, released on 14 April 2023 together with Clay Burst, in which the sealed legendary Pokémon of Paldea are set free. Chien-Pao ex and Wo-Chien ex, two of the four Treasures of Ruin, lead it: Chien-Pao ex's Ability takes up to two basic Water Energy from the deck, and its attack discards any amount of Water Energy from its player's Pokémon for 60 damage each. Annihilape ex, whose attack can do 240 damage for one Energy, Squawkabilly ex, which can discard its player's hand to draw six cards on the first turn, Slowking ex and Copperajah ex join them, with the gym leader Grusha and Team Star's Giacomo as Supporters for the first time. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 71, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Chien-Pao ex, Super Rod and basic Water Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Paldea Evolved in June 2023.
